name: SideLink Official
subtitle: Official SideLink Source
description: Official feed for SideLink-compatible IPA releases and curated apps.

news.title: SideLink Official Source
news.caption: The official feed is generated from docs/source/apps so committed IPAs publish automatically with the docs site.

apps.name: SideLink
apps.subtitle: Manage sideloaded apps from your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: The official SideLink companion app for iOS. Browse source catalogs, import your own IPAs, install apps, monitor refresh status, and manage AltStore-compatible feeds directly from your device.

versions.localizedDescription: Introduces a redesigned iPhone experience with a home feed, dedicated search, installed-app import tools, re-auth visibility, and upgraded onboarding.

privacy: LocalNetwork: Discover and pair with the SideLink desktop helper on your network
Notifications: Receive background refresh status updates

apps.name: Contrail
apps.subtitle: Automatic flight tracking for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Contrail scans your calendar for flight bookings and turns them into trackable trips with live status, gate changes, and delay alerts — all imported automatically so you never have to search for a flight number.

versions.localizedDescription: First public Contrail release through the official SideLink source.

privacy: Calendars: Scan your calendar to detect flight bookings and import them automatically.

apps.name: Cortex
apps.subtitle: Local-first LLM chat for iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Cortex is a local-first iPhone app for on-device AI conversations. It supports voice dictation, image-aware prompts, and local model workflows without making the app read like a remote chat shell first.

versions.localizedDescription: Updated Cortex build through the official SideLink source.

privacy: Camera: Capture a photo and analyze it entirely on-device with local vision models.
Photo Library: Attach images to local conversations.
Microphone: Dictate prompts directly into local conversations.
Speech Recognition: Transcribe dictated prompts before running them on-device.
